scenes.en: a carnival bloco, a street party parade where a band leads crowds of locals in costumes dancing through the streets

fantasy.en: a carnival street party in the capital — a little band of brass and drums leading a dancing crowd in feathers, sequins and painted masks through the streets, ribbon streamers and confetti fluttering from the balconies

steampunk.en: a carnival street party — a brass band with big drums leading a dancing crowd in feathered hats, sequins and painted masks through the gaslit streets, paper streamers and confetti fluttering from the iron balconies

cyberpunk.en: a carnival street party two centuries on — a band of drums and brass rimmed in light leading a dancing crowd in glowing costumes through the streets, streams of light-confetti falling from the balconies
